optional_findings.finding: Expose expansiveness as a finite-to-one map whose image of each nonempty open set is cofinite; a dense partition is equivalently a coloring that takes every color on each nonempty open set.
optional_findings.gap: None in the equivalence; equivalence alone does not settle arbitrary spaces.

optional_findings.finding: For any proper filter containing the cofinite filter, the coordinate Boolean group is expansive exactly when the filter admits a partition into finite nonempty sets eventually meeting each filter member.
optional_findings.gap: None for the stated filter/group inputs.

optional_findings.finding: The arbitrary-free-ultrafilter group excludes even point-finite expansive finite-block sequences, without requiring pairwise disjointness.
optional_findings.gap: None; point-finiteness of maximum images is the proof mechanism.

optional_findings.finding: A countable pi-base plus a dense countable partition suffices for expansiveness. The counterexample therefore has no countable pi-base and is neither first countable nor metrizable.
optional_findings.gap: None under the stated extra hypotheses.

strongest_verified_result: In ZFC an arbitrary free ultrafilter on N defines a countably infinite Hausdorff nondiscrete Boolean group with a countably infinite dense partition and no point-finite expansive sequence of finite blocks; this in particular refutes the submitted target conclusion for disjoint blocks.
proof_dependencies: Zorn lemma extension of the cofinite filter to a free ultrafilter
exact_remaining_mathematical_gap: None found in the self-contained argument for the stated target; further independent family and publication gates remain parent responsibilities.
